listing.name: Syphon Filter Redux — syphon_filter_redux (Alexbeav)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Archived native mouse/camera renderer research; successor Alexbeav/SF-pc-port based on Madxbio decomp is distinct lineage, no successor results borrowed. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA Rev1 Syphon Filter SCUS_942.40 executable and a compatible BIOS. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Clone the repository recursively and follow its archived build and play instructions. Run tools/build-windows.ps1 -GameExe with your own executable. Portcove does not manage this download and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

warnings: This archived project researches native mouse input, camera and rendering. Its successor Alexbeav/SF-pc-port uses Madxbio’s decompilation and is a distinct implementation; successor results do not establish that this archived version works. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
